about.en: MENGO is the official fan token of Clube de Regatas do Flamengo, the Brazilian football club. It is issued by Socios.com (Chiliz) as a CAP-20 token on Chiliz Chain at 0xBfF8FaBb04f6494fe393EB7416A698869569A310 and gives holders voting rights in club polls, rewards and fan-engagement features; it carries no ownership of the club.
